name: figma-fit
description: Figma design data that always fits your token budget, with a report of what was removed.
long_description: Paste a Figma frame link and Claude gets the design compacted to fit a token budget: hidden layers, empty wrappers, repeated styles and repeated components are trimmed, and the first line says what was removed. Frames too big for one response come back as a plan of smaller calls that each fit, served from a cache so they cost no extra Figma requests. Read-only: it never changes your Figma files.

tools.name: fetch_within_budget
tools.description: Fetch a Figma frame compacted to fit a token budget, or a plan of smaller calls.

tools.name: fetch_node_within_budget
tools.description: Fetch the nodes listed in a split plan (served from cache), compacted to fit the budget.

figma_token.title: Figma personal access token
figma_token.description: Create one in Figma: Settings → Security → Personal access tokens, with read-only File content access. figma-fit only ever reads.
